tools.name: get_raw_memory_status
tools.description: Report whether the local companion and game-memory writes are available.

tools.name: negotiate_gamegpt_control
tools.description: Select a mutually supported canonical control protocol version.

tools.name: list_game_processes
tools.description: List eligible local processes and the currently selected game session.

tools.name: attach_game_process
tools.description: Attach to the selected local game. Set write_enabled true when the user wants to edit its memory and the process is in the companion allowlist.

tools.name: detach_game_process
tools.description: Close the selected local game-memory session.

tools.name: start_exact_value_scan
tools.description: Start a bounded exact scan for a value the user can currently see in the selected game. ChatGPT should choose the likely type and refine after the value changes.

tools.name: start_unknown_value_scan
tools.description: Capture a bounded baseline when the current value is not displayed. ChatGPT must then ask for one clear game event and refine the same scan from that observation.

tools.name: refine_value_scan
tools.description: Filter an existing scan after one observed game change. Supply value only for an exact comparison; omit it for changed, unchanged, increased, or decreased.

tools.name: get_scan_candidates
tools.description: Read the remaining addresses and current values so ChatGPT can decide the next refinement or a user-requested verification write.

tools.name: get_learned_game_values
tools.description: Load same-build saved value observations and stable game-table features before scanning. Raw addresses from another process launch are guidance only and are explicitly marked as requiring revalidation

tools.name: mount_game_accelerator_pack
tools.description: Immediately combine exact-build local recipes, portable locators, and read-only save evidence for the selected game. Matching values are staged as restart-safe candidates. This never executes imported

tools.name: refresh_public_game_sources
tools.description: Explicitly run a bounded public-source search for the selected game and cache only metadata, feature hints, and direct CT/source links. No downloaded code or table script is executed, and this refresh

tools.name: inspect_cheat_table_reference
tools.description: Statically parse a local or public HTTPS Cheat Engine table for value hints, AOB signatures, module offsets, and structures. Auto Assembler, Lua, injection logic, and table UI are never executed or lo

tools.name: observe_game_hud
tools.description: Capture the selected foreground game window once, detect visible numeric text and HUD bars locally, then discard the pixels. Screens from other apps are refused.

tools.name: read_inventory_screen
tools.description: Capture the selected foreground game inventory once and read the visible selected item label plus current/max stack text locally. Pixels are discarded and no input or game-memory write occurs.

tools.name: read_saved_inventory
tools.description: Read typed inventory slots from the newest local No Man's Sky save. Returns item identity, amount, maximum, container group, cargo/technology classification, and grid coordinates without requiring a p

tools.name: resolve_saved_inventory_stack
tools.description: Resolve one exact No Man's Sky saved stack in the current process without writing game memory. The fast path scans only a remembered same-process allocation and validates the 0x30-byte item record plu

tools.name: observe_moved_inventory_slot
tools.description: Open a short read-only learning window for a validated exact-build inventory instruction. Ask the user to move one item stack during the window. The companion uses a temporary hardware execution break

tools.name: start_moved_inventory_observer
tools.description: Validate the exact build and unique inventory signature, start a background hardware observer, and return only after it is genuinely armed. Perform one inventory move only after this tool returns. No

tools.name: get_moved_inventory_observer
tools.description: Return or briefly wait for one armed inventory observer result. A successful result includes the stable item identity and current-launch count/max addresses.

tools.name: cancel_moved_inventory_observer
tools.description: Cancel one active inventory observer, restore its debug registers, and detach.

tools.name: start_instruction_value_observer
tools.description: Arm a short read-only hardware observation from a data-only translated CT or source recipe. The exact executable build and unique AOB must match. It captures one x64 register and reads typed structure

tools.name: get_instruction_value_observer
tools.description: Return or briefly wait for a translated instruction observer result, including current-launch field addresses, values, and source provenance.

tools.name: cancel_instruction_value_observer
tools.description: Cancel one translated instruction observer, restore debug registers, and detach.

tools.name: sync_game_table_registry
tools.description: Inspect, pull, stage, or explicitly publish data-only exact-build game tables in the configured private registry. Attach auto-loads from the local checkout and never waits on the network. Raw addresse

tools.name: remember_value_scan
tools.description: Persist every candidate from an untruncated scan of at most 20 results. Supply verified_addresses only for candidates already confirmed by a write/readback test.

tools.name: control_game_command_overlay
tools.description: Start, inspect, or stop the small always-on-top Windows command box. Ctrl+Shift+G toggles it and GPT Voice opens native Codex Voice. Stopping is cooperative and never terminates an unverified process.

tools.name: wait_for_game_command
tools.description: Wait up to 30 seconds for a local keyboard or voice command from the overlay. Pass the prior command ID as acknowledge_id only after acting on it.

tools.name: set_game_command_overlay_message
tools.description: Show a short GPT progress or result message in the in-game command overlay.

tools.name: read_game_memory
tools.description: Read a typed scalar at a decimal memory address in the selected game. Supported types are i8, u8, i16, u16, i32, u32, i64, u64, f32, and f64.

tools.name: write_game_memory
tools.description: Write a typed scalar at a decimal address in the selected write-enabled game and return the previous value plus verified readback. expected_current is optional; when supplied, a mismatch stops the wri

tools.name: rollback_game_memory_write
tools.description: Restore the original value using a receipt token. The rollback is refused if the process or current value changed after the verified write.
